#libraries
```{r}
library(AnaCoDa)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
```

#initialize genome with old genome
```{r}
genome <- initializeGenomeObject(file = "fasta/cleaned_random_1000.fasta")
```

#follow steps in CUB project Rmd to retrieve csp_long and synth_trace from old genome


#then extract phi value
```{r}
phi_sample_49 <- synth_trace %>%
  select(id_names, `49`) %>%
  rename(Mean = `49`)

write.csv(phi_sample_49, "phi_estimates_sample49.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#extract mutation (dM) and selection (dEta) values
```{r}
csp_sample_49 <- csp_long %>%
  filter(Sample == 49)

dM_estimates_49 <- csp_sample_49 %>%
  select(Codon, Mutation)

dEta_estimates_49 <- csp_sample_49 %>%
  select(Codon, Selection)

write.csv(dM_estimates_49, "dM_estimates_sample49.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dEta_estimates_49, "dEta_estimates_sample49.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


#checking step
```{r}
# Check if gene names match
phi_ids <- phi_sample_49$id_names
genome_ids <- getNames(genome)

# Check for mismatches
missing_in_phi <- setdiff(genome_ids, phi_ids)
missing_in_genome <- setdiff(phi_ids, genome_ids)

# Print mismatches if any
if (length(missing_in_phi) > 0) {
  cat("Genes missing in phi file:\n")
  print(missing_in_phi)
} else {
  cat("✅ All genome genes are found in phi file!\n")
}

if (length(missing_in_genome) > 0) {
  cat("Genes missing in genome object:\n")
  print(missing_in_genome)
} else {
  cat("✅ All phi genes are found in genome object!\n")
}

```

#simulate
```{r}
simulateGenomeROC <- function(
  genome.obj,
  deta.file,
  dM.file,
  phi.file,
  phi.column = "Mean"
) {
  #' Simulate a genome using parameter estimates from previous model fitting
  #' @param genome.obj: your Genome object (from AnaCoDa)
  #' @param deta.file: CSV file with estimated selection parameters (Δη)
  #' @param dM.file: CSV file with estimated mutation parameters (ΔM)
  #' @param phi.file: CSV file with estimated synthesis rates (ϕ)
  #' @param phi.column: which column to use for phi (default "Mean")
  
  # Load phi estimates
  phi.values <- read.csv(phi.file, header = TRUE)[, phi.column]
  
  # Initialize a new parameter object using your old phi values
  parameter <- initializeParameterObject(
    genome.obj,
    sphi = c(0.01),  # small nonzero sphi (shouldn't matter much for simulation)
    num.mixtures = 1,
    gene.assignment = rep(1, length(genome.obj)),
    mixture.definition = "allUnique",
    initial.expression.values = phi.values,
    split.serine = TRUE
  )
  
  # Load estimated mutation and selection parameters
  parameter$initSelectionCategories(deta.file, 1, FALSE)
  parameter$initMutationCategories(dM.file, 1, FALSE)
  
  # Create a new model object without new phi estimation (fixed phi)
  model <- initializeModelObject(parameter, model = "ROC", with.phi = FALSE)
  
  # Simulate a new genome based on the model parameters
  model$simulateGenome(genome.obj)
  
  return(genome.obj)
}
```

#using sample 49 params
```{r}
# simulate the genome based on your sample 49 parameter estimates
simulated_genome <- simulateGenomeROC(
  genome.obj = genome,
  deta.file = "dEta_estimates_sample49.csv",
  dM.file = "dM_estimates_sample49.csv",
  phi.file = "phi_estimates_sample49.csv",
  phi.column = "Mean"
)
```
